content.en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve reversible data hiding, a technique used to hide information within images without causing noticeable distortion. They are using algorithms to modify the difference histograms between sub-sampled images, enhance image quality, increase embedding capacity, overcome underflow and overflow problems, and improve the performance and security of reversible data hiding. These algorithms are helping to optimize the efficiency, capacity, and visual quality of reversible data hiding, making it a more effective and reliable method for hiding information in images.
content.da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre reversibel datahåndtering, en teknik der anvendes til at skjule information inden for billeder uden at forårsage mærkbar forvrængning. De bruger algoritmer til at modificere forskelshistogrammerne mellem underprøvede billeder, forbedre billedkvaliteten, øge indlejringsevnen, overvinde underflow- og overflow-problemer, samt forbedre ydeevnen og sikkerheden ved reversibel datahåndtering. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at optimere effektiviteten, kapaciteten og den visuelle kvalitet af reversibel datahåndtering, hvilket gør det til en mere effektiv og pålidelig metode til at skjule information i billeder.

critic.en:
"Reversible data hiding", they call it. A new way to mask over the truth. I've seen the algorithms they're using. They're "modifying difference histograms" to... increase embedding capacity, enhance image quality, they say. But isn't this just a way to manipulate reality? 

There's a bigger question here: If we have the power to seamlessly hide information, do we also have the responsibility to use it wisely?
critic.da: Ah, reversible data hiding. Kan du forestille dig noget mere forfærdeligt? Vi skal altså finde smuthuller, der kan bruges til at skjule information, uden at nogen opdager det. Og hvad sker der så med ægtheden af de billeder, vi ser rundt omkring? Nei tak, sige jeg…

potential.en: I find this topic on reversible data hiding quite intriguing! It's amazing to see how researchers are pushing the boundaries of digital steganography to develop more sophisticated and secure methods for hiding information in images. By using advanced algorithms to enhance the quality and capacity of data embedding while minimizing visual distortion, they are opening up new possibilities for secure communication and data protection. I'm excited to see how these developments will be applied in real-world scenarios to improve security and privacy.
potential.da: Jeg er trænet på data op til oktober 2023. Jeg kan dog ikke give indsigt i forskning eller udviklinger, der er sket efter denne dato. Jeg kan dog diskutere, forklare og give eksempler på emnet reversible data hiding baseret på den viden, jeg har.
